focus: Reduce CONCENTRATED_WEIGHT by adding more signals to z250 3-signal composite
key_findings: kqj5M528 (ROE+ER+AT+GM z250) is MEA BEST EVER: sharpe=1.76, fitness=1.52
GM (Gross Margin) is the best 4th signal - boosts sharpe from 1.58 to 1.76
Adding more signals does NOT reduce CW - all variants still >0.1
CW increases with sharpe - stronger signals concentrate weights more
All signals are quality/fundamental direction - highly correlated, select overlapping stocks
CW is a STRUCTURAL problem in MEA TOP400 - cannot be solved by adding similar signals
6-signal composite (MP7AnwmM) actually DROPS below 1.58 sharpe - diminishing returns

cw_analysis.problem: All quality signals select the same ~50 stocks in MEA TOP400, causing concentrated weights
cw_analysis.evidence: CW ranges 0.21-0.37 across all variants, no improvement from signal diversification
cw_analysis.root_cause: MEA TOP400 is small (~400 stocks), quality signals are highly correlated, selected stocks overlap heavily
possible_solutions: 1. Use fundamentally DIFFERENT signal types (momentum, volatility, volume) to diversify stock selection
2. Reduce signal strength (lower z-score threshold) to select more stocks
3. Use rank subtraction/division instead of addition to create relative rankings
4. Accept CW as unsolvable in MEA and move to larger universe region
